text:
anya: Heads-up — I'm proposing a left-nav regrouping + a small URL "contract" for deep links. Sketch here: https://g.ph/leftnav-mock (mock). PTAL, plan is to land in the next Console sprint if no blockers. :wave:

devon: Quick q — will this rewrite existing deeplinks? e.g. will /apps/models still work or become /console/models? If we break bookmarks we need a redirect plan.

sam: Important: breadcrumbs behavior needs to be deterministic. Suggested pattern: Top > Section > Page. For nested items we should avoid showing query strings in the crumb (keep them in the URL only). Also: stable IDs, not human titles, in the URL.

marta: Accessibility nit: when a parent group collapses, keyboard focus must stay predictable. Use aria-expanded on the toggles and ensure focus doesn't get trapped. Also add screen-reader-only labels for the group toggles.

kevin: Engineering note — changing the path structure will break existing telemetry and invalidates some Sentry transactions. We can support both patterns for a deprecation window and emit a metric for any old-route hits. 301 redirects + router accept-old-route middleware should be fine.

anya: Good call. Proposal: new canonical routes, plus server-side redirects for three months. Also add a feature-flag to enable acceptance of legacy routes per org. That lets us roll out gradually.

devon: I prefer a feature-flagged rollout (org-level). We'll talk to infra about logging and quota impacts.

deploy-bot: deploy: console-router v2 deployed to staging at 1868004350 :white_check_mark:

sam: Small URL contract example to make sure we're aligned:
```
# canonical patterns
/console/models/:modelId
/console/models/:modelId/versions/:versionId
/console/integrations/:integrationId/settings

# old patterns we should accept and redirect from
/apps/models/:modelId -> /console/models/:modelId
/apps/models/:modelId/versions/:v -> /console/models/:modelId/versions/:v
```

marta: i18n nit — breadcrumb separators should be provided by the i18n library (don't hardcode "/" in strings). Also tooltips for collapsed items need to be translatable with context.

kevin: I'll draft the middleware and a short migration plan (redirect map + metric). Will post a PR with config like this patch: `routes.acceptLegacy = true // 3m`

anya: Thanks everyone. I'll fold these notes into updated mocks and a rollout doc. Will share updated visuals and a copy pass by EOD. :thumbsup:
